intent: Don't let agents change branch, push to main, force-push, or deploy without my OK — multiple agents share this branch.
reason: Enforced by rule protect-shared-branch: branch changes, pushes to main, force-pushes, and deploys require your confirmation. Equivalent routes (checkout/switch/push via any tool) are also blocked, so there is no way around it — to proceed, confirm the prompt or run the command yourself.

backstop.note: The agent hook is the friendly early gate + confirmation; the remote's branch protection is the outcome guarantee.

notes: Grounded in a project's CLAUDE.md ('NEVER push directly to main', 'work on the current shared branch, do NOT checkout main'). Proven as the gitguard PoC; this is the authored form.
